"''And what exactly are you guarding?|The Stormtrooper Commander and Kanan Jarrus|}} A '''Stormtrooper Commander''' holding the rank of [[corporal]] served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. When [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Ezra Bridger]] of the [[Spectres]] rebel cell [[Infiltration of the Imperial Armory Complex|infiltrated]] the [[Imperial Armory Complex]] on [[Lothal]] in Imperial [[armor]], the [[Stormtrooper Commander]] questioned the two outside of [[Section A-2]]. The Jedi claimed they were new transfers, looking for [[Section B-17]]. However, the stormtrooper was not fooled and they ordered their troopers to pursue the rebel infiltrators. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The Stormtrooper Commander is voiced by [[Clancy Brown]], who also provides the voice of [[Ryder Azadi]]. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|An Inside Man}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Stormtrooper Commanders]]
